title: Bring network devices down
summary: Deactivate one or more network interfaces, bringing them down to stop connectivity.

steps.explain: Use sudo to bring the specified network interfaces down. Replace <INTERFACE> with the name of the interface.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to bring down.

rollback.explain: To undo this, bring the interface up again.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The name of the network interface to bring up.

warnings: Bringing an interface down will disconnect you from the network if it is your primary connection.
